statement: A settlement that takes collateral out (C2R) is co-signed only if both sides stay within their credit afterwards, the same RCPAN bound a payment meets; otherwise it is refused, never signed. The ts cell holds the ledger-level refusal; the approver that maps signed diffs to a withdrawal is owed A4. The Quint cell holds the predicate `settlementOk`, checked against the chain's payout in compose.qnt; no Account or settle action calls it, so the co-signing path itself is not in the model.
